notes.title: The Star Named EOS - Summer 2024 Release and Voice Actress Announcements
notes.notes:
We're very excited to announce the voice actresses who will be providing their voices for The Star Named EOS in three different languages!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157516/c99c692640fe371828535cc9bc7f7aaa6707288a.png[/img]

Japanese Voiceover: Aoi Yuki
A Japanese voice actress with notable roles such as Madoka Kaname (Puella Magi Madoka Magica), Tanya Degurechaff (The Saga of Tanya the Evil), Sayaka Natori (Your Name), Futaba Sakura (Persona 5), and The Traveler/Lumine (Genshin Impact), among others.

English Voiceover: Suzie Yeung
An Asian-American voice actress with notable roles such as Makima (Chainsaw Man), Eula (Genshin Impact), and Yuffie (Final Fantasy VII Remake), among others.

Chinese Voiceover: Shandy Ma
A Taiwanese voice actress with various roles across media. From audio guide narrations for the Forbidden Palace in Beijing and the National Museum of Taiwan History to advertisement narrations for various household brands, her voice is a familiar one to the Taiwanese.

The Steam demo has now been updated to include the new voiceovers. Why not take the opportunity to immerse yourself in the game's world before release?

notes.title: The Star Named EOS will Release in Spring 2024!
notes.notes:
The Star Named EOS is planned to release in Spring 2024!

The Star Named EOS is an adventure game where you follow in the footsteps of a young photographer's mother and use a camera to solve puzzles.

It will support multiple languages from the UI to the story: English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish, and Russian.

[previewyoutube=6gAbBf2QGEs;full][/previewyoutube]
Please add the game to your wishlist while you wait!

Here's some more great news...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157516/aa92cb5daa6ef3836d02a97d85a79810e66e6328.jpg[/img]

 The Star Named EOS has received the Best Visuals Award at GWB2023! 

[quote=GWB2023 Comment]GWB2023 Comment

The Star Named EOS combines its beautiful hand-drawn art and story-heavy puzzle mechanics brilliantly. It’s a game full of fantastic and captivating experiences. [/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157516/9212bffa6147dae9f6382a67beb7f6aa90d4f482.jpg[/img]
